description: Walk the DNSSEC chain from the root to one answer: DS and DNSKEY at each signed zone cut, key tags, signers, signature windows, the first link that breaks or goes insecure, and whether the zone where it goes insecure is itself signed (an island of security). Not for one signed record: dig. Read through Cloudflare's resolver over DoH with CD=1 from the isitdns edge, and a key set a break would rest on again through Google's. Signature bytes are not verified, so a clean walk does not prove the answer validates. type (default A) is the record checked at the end, not OPT, RRSIG or a meta type such as ANY, and anchor (a DS or DNSKEY record, with anchor_zone) starts the walk at that zone instead of the root.

anchor.description: A trust anchor: "DS <key tag> <algorithm> <digest type> <digest>" or "DNSKEY <flags> <protocol> <algorithm> <key>", optionally led by its owner name

anchor_zone.description: The zone the anchor belongs to: the name or a parent of it. Optional when the anchor record leads with its owner

name.description: The name, e.g. www.example.com. Also as "domain"; a URL is read as its host.

type.description: The record type to check at the end of the chain

name: dnssec_chain

anchor.description: The supplied anchor: zone, kind, record, keyTag, algorithm, match

answer.description: The end: rcode, records, signatures, denial, problems

api.description: The /api GET that asks it again, as a new reading

firstBreak.description: The first link that breaks: at, why, readFrom (the resolvers whose readings it rests on)

insecureAt.description: The zone where it goes insecure

islandAt.description: insecureAt when that zone is itself signed: an island of security; null when it is not, or when that was not judged (notChecked says why)

links.description: One per zone cut: zone, DS, key tags and roles, signer, problems, readFrom

receipts.description: One per DNS read: what, of whom, from where, when, rcode, flags, EDE, ms, answer

signaturesVerified.description: Always false: signature bytes are not checked

title: Walk the DNSSEC chain
